gbm_population_flag.reason: Official title names recurrent glioblastoma (title counts under D27B), but brief title, conditions, eligibility, arms and outcomes all describe HPV-positive oropharyngeal SCC; the official title appears to be a registry error.

candidate_evidence.quote: Participants will receive neoadjuvant nogapendekin alfa inbakicept (NAI), hAd5-HPV vaccine (IBRX-042), and nab-paclitaxel followed by de-intensified intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) with concurrent cisplatin, and post-radiation NAI and IBRX-042.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: No prior definitive treatment for the current OPSCC.

role_evidence.quote: NAI 1.2 mg administered subcutaneously as part of the experimental treatment regimen.
IBRX-042 administered subcutaneously as part of the experimental treatment regimen.

coder_notes: Record is internally inconsistent: official title describes a recurrent glioblastoma study (NAI, PD-L1 t-haNK, bevacizumab, TTFields), but every other field describes HPV-positive oropharyngeal SCC. Coded on the substantive content as not_glioblastoma; flagged for adjudication. If treated as GBM, candidate coding would need re-check. Cisplatin is in Phase 2a and both randomised arms (registered intervention list for Phase 2a omits it but arm text says concurrent cisplatin). HPV positivity is a tumour (viral) marker; HPV vaccine targets HPV antigens but vaccine is not a candidate, so not candidate-matched. Treatment setting for OPSCC is untreated locally advanced disease, not a GBM setting; coded unclear. Arm B is a registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR.
